title: Analista de Custos Pleno
description:
PRIO – Rio de Janeiro, RJ – Brazil

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Custos Pleno para atuar de forma estratégica na gestão dos custos logísticos da companhia. Essa posição será responsável por garantir visibilidade, precisão, eficiência e governança sobre todos os gastos relacionados à área de Logística.

Responsabilidade principal da vaga

  • Controlar, analisar e consolidar os custos logísticos (OPEX e CAPEX) de ponta a ponta, abrangendo transporte marítimo, transporte aéreo, logística de pessoas, combustíveis, bases operacionais, operações de apoio e logística terrestre.

Demais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar custos e performance das operações logísticas, garantindo aderência a contratos, premissas orçamentárias e padrões regulatórios.
  • Planejar e controlar a demanda de serviços logísticos, alinhando necessidades operacionais com fornecedores e requisitos internos.
  • Apoiar a construção e revisão do orçamento logístico, com análise crítica de variações e premissas.
  • Atuar em projetos de tecnologia aplicados à logística, como implantação ou melhoria de sistemas de gestão, planejamento e rastreamento.
  • Desenvolver análises e iniciativas de redução de custos, buscando alternativas de mercado, otimização operacional e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Superior Completa.
  • Experiência com análise e controle de custos, preferencialmente em logística.
  • Inglês intermediário é diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de SAP e Power BI avançado.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Social Investment Senior Advisor
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group: Corporate Relations

Worker Type: Regular

Posting Start Date: December 9, 2025

Business Unit: CoS and Corporate Relations

Experience Level: Experienced Professionals

What’s the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment. You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact-led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner Mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Social Investment Senior Advisor

Join to apply for the Social Investment Senior Advisor role at Shell.

What’s The Role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment.

You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact‑led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What You Bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What We Offer

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell in Brazil

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer‑focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell‑branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

We are seeking a Network Engineer to join the Upstream Computer Operations Department.

The Upstream Computer Operations Department is responsible for supporting the network infrastructure across two main upstream data centers, two disaster recovery sites, and 14 user buildings. The scope includes configuring and managing access, distribution switches, and core routers, as well as security infrastructure such as firewalls, NAC, and IDPS, and providing support for load balancers and critical network services like DNS and DHCP.

Your primary role is to support the Upstream Digital Center (UDC) network infrastructure and services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operating and maintaining the UDC network infrastructure, including data center networks, user building networks, and DR site networks.
  • Troubleshooting and resolving complex network issues using tools like Wireshark, tcpdump, and network simulators.
  • Developing and implementing network automation scripts and workflows using tools like Ansible, Python, and Terraform.
  • Ensuring the stability, security, and performance of all network systems, including cloud-based services and DR sites.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Developing and maintaining technical documentation and diagrams of network systems, including data center networks, user building networks, and DR site networks.
  • Staying up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies, and making recommendations for network upgrades and improvements.

  • Participating in on-call rotations and providing 24/7 support as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Communication Engineering, or Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • 10+ years of experience in network engineering and architecture on carrier IP networks with hands‑on routing, switching, and load balancing experience in a cloud provider environment.
  • 7+ years of experience in IP networks (running Ethernet, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, Layer 2 Switching, VRFs, etc.).
  • 7+ years of experience troubleshooting and resolving complex routing and switching problems in an IP‑based carrier network.
  • Experience with Linux and excellent knowledge of core network services (DNS, SMTP, NTP, syslog, HTTP).
  • Experience with programming Python or shell scripting, especially as it relates to SDN.
  • Expert‑level knowledge in routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPBGP, MPLS).
  • Strong knowledge of IPv6, multicast, QoS, IP fast rerouting, IPSec VPN, DMVPN, and VPLS.
  • Strong knowledge in network security and enterprise security, such as DDOS, firewall, IPS, malware detection, etc.
  • Experience in designing internet backbone networks including a solid understanding of best practices, scalability strategy, and managed security services.
  • Knowledge of SDN, NFV, and SD‑WAN.
  • Preferred certifications: Cisco or Juniper ‘E’ level, additional security and VoIP certifications, CCNP, CCIE, JNCIS, JNCIP, JNCIE.

title: Inspection Supervisor
description:
Motive Offshore Group specialises in the design, manufacture, rental, and inspection of marine and lifting equipment and is committed to delivering sustainable, innovative, and multi‑sector solutions.

We have many exciting opportunities globally as we rapidly expand our reach, especially in low‑carbon and energy transition areas.

Our People are our most valuable asset. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative, and collaborative workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to achieve their full potential. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and are dedicated to creating a culture of equity and belonging.

About the role

Hours: Full‑Time

The Inspection Supervisor will lead and supervise all inspection, NDT, and rope‑access activities. The role includes ensuring full compliance with IRATA Level III rigging and safety requirements. Duties involve planning, coordinating, and carrying out routine and periodic surveys using the full range of NDT methods and inspection equipment. Onsite training, mentoring, and performance oversight for Inspectors are also key components of the position, as is undertaking all tasks associated with a Level III Rope Access Supervisor.

Additional responsibilities include ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest technical standards, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and contributing to the development and implementation of inspection procedures and best practices.

Responsibilities

People

  • Adopt and promote the Motive Offshore Group People Values and ensure their use is embedded throughout.
  • Develop strong working relations with key stakeholders – clients, colleagues, etc.
  • Act as a positive ambassador for Motive Offshore Group Ltd.
  • Uphold the Motive Offshore Group People Values.

Planet

  • Lead by example in setting the highest possible standards in the promotion of People Values, HSEQ procedures and best practice, ensuring compliance to the Motive Offshore Group HSEQ Policy, procedures, standards and regulatory obligations.
  • Immediately report all accidents, incidents, near misses or environmental concerns.
  • Adhere to and participate in company‑wide sustainability policies, procedures and initiatives as they are developed to support our Net Zero objectives.

Product

  • Provide Rope Access supervision, advice and support.
  • Perform Rope Access activities and act as Level III Rope Access Supervisor for tasks such as NDT, structural installations and removals, shot blasting and painting.
  • Rig up and inspect rope access equipment prior to and during use.
  • Carry out routine surveys, inspections and load testing of lifting equipment and their accessories, and immediately report defects or concerns.
  • Maintain the compilation of all hours undertaken for rope access activities and report findings to the rope access manager.
  • Mentor other Spooling and Inspection Rope Access Technicians.
  • Ensure all rope access equipment is maintained.
  • Attend rope access refresher and other associated training as required.
  • Where qualified, carry out visual and NDT examination of all types of high‑performance wire rope.
  • Where qualified, carry out pressure lubrication of all types of high‑performance wire ropes in accordance with working procedures and COSHH assessments.
  • Complete Daily Client Service Record and Rope Access forms in full, with accurate times and descriptions, obtaining signed approval from the client where required.
  • Properly set up equipment.
  • Use Kinetic Software for the review, approval and production of good‑quality inspection reports ready to send to customers.
  • Travel to worldwide destinations as and when required.

Required skills / knowledge

  • Significant offshore experience.
  • Suitable NDT certification (SNT or PCN Level II).
  • IRATA Rope Access Level III.
  • Offshore certification.
  • Experience operating machinery.
  • Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team.
  • Ability to prioritise.
  • Strong organisational skills with a good ability to prioritise and work to deadlines.
  • Ability to cope with change in a busy working environment.

What we can offer you

As a global business, you will be colleagues with people not only in the UK but also in Taiwan, Singapore, the UAE, Norway, Brazil and the US. You will be part of our people‑centred approach that supports clients and projects across multiple countries. Motive has enabled school leavers to advance to senior positions, relocate to other parts of the world, and develop technical skills through training.

How to Apply & what happens next

Send us a resume with any supporting documents telling us why you’d like to work with us at Motive Offshore Group. Once we’ve reviewed your application, we’ll be back in touch as soon as possible to update you on the next stages. Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta e biodiversidade.

title: College Research Administration Manager
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! Benefits & Wellness

Basic Function

Howard University seeks a dynamic and skilled College Research Administration Manager to oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges. This hybrid reporting role is pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission by ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows. The manager will handle pre‑ and post‑award responsibilities, working collaboratively with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary POC for all assigned departments within the college for pre‑award and post‑award support. This position has a primary reporting line to the Office of Research for strategic oversight, training, and compliance. A dotted‑line reporting relationship with the Associate Dean for Research allows for alignment with the day‑to‑day priorities of the assigned college. The incumbent will serve as a bridge between central oversight and college‑specific needs, ensuring the success of research activities across the institution. External contacts include representatives from the federal government, other colleges and universities, professional associations, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre‑Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post‑Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university‑wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in effective multi‑tasking in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization, strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a busy, high‑volume, and deadline‑driven work team environment that requires coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to reprioritize to accommodate emergency request.
  • Must be able to speak confidently when communicating with investigators and internal and external research stakeholders, excellent customer service skills, and outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Incumbents must be able to write and interpret technical contract language, understand its implications, and effectively communicate with and serve as liaisons between granting agencies, University administration, and the principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS (foreign equivalent or higher) in Business, Finance, Accounting, or other related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non‑specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross‑functional, fast‑paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description cannot be construed as a contract for employment.

Job Overview

The Principal Cost Controls Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices to improve cost and schedule. They will be tasked with solving complex cost management problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Cost Controls Specialist may be required to guide junior personnel. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in costing and broad knowledge of the costing discipline within the project controls function.

Responsibilities

  • Implement McDermott processes and systems on projects.
  • Lead the project controls team on large and highly complex EPC projects.
  • Implement constructability concepts, (the how it’s built) and related interdependencies between Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction in support of the Advanced Work Planning (AWP) process.
  • Support the development of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) on complex projects with multiple partners and compensation types.
  • Implement internal and contractual requirements on the project via the project controls execution plan.
  • Lead setup and implementation of project controls systems.
  • Responsible for the accuracy of project controls reports.
  • Analyze and interpret cost forecasting and trending.
  • Recommends solutions or recovery plans for problem areas.
  • Lead preparation and review of the project monthly forecast.
  • Support the Project Controls Team in development of the cost spread and cash flows.
  • Participate in proposal development, commercial alignment and project kickoff processes.
  • Supervise and train junior personnel in all aspects of cost reporting.
  • Lead the set up and maintenance of the progress measurement system.
  • Implement and support the Change Management process.
  • Lead change management efforts, including building of cost estimates and apply or manage amendments to the contract.
  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.
  • Support the development and implementation of the Project Risk and Opportunity process.
  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management is preferred or
  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.
  • Must have experience in a large-scale mega-project in Oil & Gas and Offshore Construction.

  • Experienced in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Great communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.

  • Understand the relationship between estimating, cost management, progress, schedule, and project accounting.

SOBRE A NIP DO BRASIL
Somos uma empresa de engenharia consultiva especializada em soluções para infraestrutura, energia e meio ambiente. Atuamos com inovação, precisão técnica e responsabilidade socioambiental. Nossa missão é transformar desafios em soluções sustentáveis, gerando impacto positivo para o Brasil e suas comunidades.

Missão da Posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos eletromecânicos de linhas de transmissão até 138kV, com foco em qualidade técnica, atendimento aos requisitos normativos e prazos contratuais. Contribuir de forma estratégica para o desempenho dos projetos da NIP, liderando entregas técnicas, interações com clientes e acompanhando a equipe de engenharia.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Levantar dados preliminares de campo e referências técnicas (topografia, georreferenciamento, interferências, servidões, condicionantes ambientais).
  • Definir traçado da linha, escolher o melhor percurso considerando restrições técnicas, ambientais e custos, com otimização de rota.
  • Dimensionar eletromecânica e elétrica da linha (condutores, para-raios, isoladores, espaçamentos, esforços de tração e flecha), incorporando critérios de amortecimento, vibração e fadiga.
  • Projetar estruturas de sustentação (torres, postes), definindo tipologia, perfis, empenos, cargas de vento, gelo (quando aplicável) e requisitos de fabricação.
  • Projetar fundações para torres / postes com base nos levantamentos geotécnicos e cargas atuantes.
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos e memoriais de cálculo que detalhem hipóteses adotadas, normas aplicadas, critérios de dimensionamento e justificativas técnicas.
  • Produzir desenhos executivos e detalhamentos (plantas, cortes longitudinais e transversais, arranjos, fixações, grampos, emendas).
  • Definir o sistema de aterramento das estruturas e condutores, malha de terra compatível com segurança elétrica e regulamentos.
  • Realizar compatibilização técnica com disciplinas complementares (civil, proteção, telecomunicações, automação), garantindo integração dos projetos.
  • Aplicar e garantir conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais (ABNT, IEC, normas de concessionárias) e regulamentos setoriais.
  • Adaptar projetos conforme requisitos contratuais de clientes ou exigências de concessionárias / clientes, acompanhando revisões e solicitações.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes, fornecedores, órgãos reguladores e equipes de obra para alinhamento de soluções, esclarecimento de dúvidas e decisões de projeto.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas de projeto, distribuir tarefas entre equipe de projetistas, revisar entregas, monitorar prazos e qualidade técnica.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais para acompanhamento de status do projeto, performance da equipe, indicadores de progresso e apoio à gestão.
  • Apoiar a execução da obra fornecendo suporte técnico, esclarecimentos de campo, checagem de conformidade entre projeto e execução e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Garantir que o projeto atenda requisitos de confiabilidade, manutenibilidade, durabilidade e segurança elétrica ao longo do ciclo de vida da linha.

Requisitos Técnicos

Escolaridade / Qualificação Desejada: Técnico em Eletrotécnica

  • Técnico em Eletrônica ou Eletroeletrônica
  • Técnico em Desenho de Projetos ou Técnico em Edificações (com experiência em projetos elétricos)
  • Technólogo em Sistemas Elétricos, Energias Renováveis ou Projetos Industriais
  • Desejável Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrotécnica, Engenharia Eletromecânica ou Engenharia de Energia.
  • Conhecimentos Avançados em softwares de cálculo e modelagem elétrica/mecânica (ex: Autocad, PLS‑CADD, MATLAB, AutoCAD, ferramentas de análise de estruturas).
  • Residir em Fortaleza - CE;

description:
Title

Perinatal Sonographer

About the Role

We seek a dedicated professional with expertise in high-risk obstetric imaging to support the Maternal Fetal Medicine/Perinatology department at Howard University. The full‑time position offers a four‑day work week and focuses on daily sonographic laboratory operations, equipment maintenance, and continuous quality assessment of imaging services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform all requested sonographic examinations as ordered, including 1st to 3rd trimester, limited, transvaginal exams, and biophysical profiles.
  • Explain procedures, prepare patients, and support families in a compassionate manner.
  • Verify accuracy of requisitions, gather pertinent history, and provide summary findings to supervising physicians.
  • Assist perinatologists with invasive procedures such as amniocentesis.
  • Maintain equipment, report failures, and perform daily pre‑visit planning.
  • Prepare preliminary reports on the Viewpoint system in accordance with FPP and billing policies.
  • Implement infection control, safety, and HIPAA compliance; protect PHI.
  • Collaborate with physicians, nurses, genetic counselors, and other staff to ensure comprehensive patient care.
  • Serve as communication liaison and coordinate urgent patient needs.
  • Participate in continuing education and critical‑thinking activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management or physicians.

Essential Qualifications

  • Completion of an approved diagnostic medical sonography curriculum or equivalent background.
  • Current or registry‑eligible ARDMS registration in Obstetrics and Gynecology.
  • Preferred one‑year OB experience or recent internship in obstetrics or MFM clinic; new graduates welcome.
  • Preferred Basic Life Support and CPR certification.Certification in nuchal translucency (NTQR or Fetal Maternal Foundation) or ability to obtain within 6 months of employment.

Competencies

  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work with limited supervision.
  • Meet national matrix standards for high‑quality patient care and diagnostic imaging services.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

Professional medical office setting, fast‑paced, diverse population, frequent exposure to contagious diseases and bodily fluids. Requires use of computers, phones, office equipment.

Benefits

  • Health, dental & vision insurance; mental health support.
  • Paid time off, holidays, flexible work arrangements.
  • Expected Pay Range: $118,18 - $130,000.
  • 403(b) with company match.
  • Tuition reimbursement and other professional development opportunities.

Employment Details

  • Classification: Hourly

  • Department: Maternal Fetal Medicine/Perinatology
  • Reports To: Lead Sonographer, Supervising Physician, Clinic Manager
  • Seniority level: Entry level
  • Employment type: Full‑time

title: Psicólogo - Nefrologia | Banco de Talentos
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver!
QUEM SOMOS:
A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.
Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.
Descrição :
Responsável por garantir o bom estado geral do paciente renal crônico em tratamento dialítico, colaborando na resolução de problemas psicológicos, trabalhando a autonomia e engajamento do paciente, respeitando sua individualidade.
Garantir a aderência do paciente renal ao tratamento dialítico, analisando e intervindo nas situações de não aderência, assim como nas situações de faltas às sessões de diálise.

  • O que você irá realizar
  • Entrevistar os pacientes novos na unidade, registrando os dados no prontuário do paciente ou meio eletrônico (somente serão registradas informações que tenham relevância ao tratamento dialítico);
  • Acompanhar o estado psicológico do paciente através de atendimento aos pacientes em diálise periodicamente, avaliando a pertinência de intervenções específicas e assistindo individualmente aqueles que necessitem;
  • Favorecer um ambiente adequado de diálise, a fim de propiciar a aderência do paciente ao tratamento, tornando o tempo de diálise em momento produtivo;
  • Trabalhar visando à integração entre pacientes;
  • Orientar os pacientes e familiares proporcionando o acesso envolvimento ao seu tratamento, por meio da educação continuada e juntamente equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Promover a integração da equipe multidisciplinar x pacientes e um apoio para as dificuldades encontradas no lidar com o paciente renal crônico através da realização de reuniões com a equipe de saúde;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas com pacientes, objetivando esclarecer dúvidas e orienta-los quanto às implicações emocionais e comportamentais no tratamento dialítico;
  • Analisar mensalmente relatórios de faltas de pacientes as sessões de diálise e realizar plano de ação visando melhorar a aderência do paciente renal a sessão;
  • Solicitar a presença de pacientes/familiares em eventos sociais auxiliando na promoção destes eventos juntamente com serviço Social;
  • Representar a ouvidoria do paciente junto à Unidade de Diálise e encaminhar reclamações/solicitações pertinentes aos setores competentes;
  • Garantir o registro das informações psicológicas do paciente através da confecção das evoluções periódicas no prontuário do paciente ou me meio eletrônico;
  • Participar de processos institucionais, programas e/ou projetos corporativos estabelecendo um relacionamento adequado com os clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões técnicas, administrativas e multidisciplinares (Reuniões de Qualidade, PCPIEA, etc) da unidade visando melhoria continua dos resultados da unidade;
  • Participar de reuniões e resultados clínicos da unidade, visando à elaboração de plano de ação para situações (Relatório de faltas às sessões, problemas relacionados à não aderência, e outros);
  • Garantir a autorização para atuar na empresa através do cumprimento das obrigações legais mediante ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia assim como cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética e atendimento aos requisitos legais.
  • Esperamos que você tenha
  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia;
  • CRP ativo e regular;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento clínico em Nefrologia;
  • Desejável especialização em Psicologia Clínica;
  • Disponibilidade para cumprir 30 horas semanais e/ou 44 horas semanais
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro
  • Oferecemos: Salário e Benefícios compatíveis ao mercado.

Na Fresenius oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.
A Fresenius Medical Care agradece o seu interesse e disponibilidade em participar de nosso processo seletivo!

title: Assessor Tributário Sênior
description:
Pessoa Assessor(a) Tributária Sênior

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Tax para serviços financeiros (Tax FSO), estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro (Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos). Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

#TAXFSO

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma Pessoa Assessor(a) Tributária Sênior você será parte da área de Tax com foco na indústria financeira, atuando em consultoria tributária, auxiliando as empresas em projetos de compliance e consultoria em impostos (CSLL, IRPJ, PIS, COFINS) para bancos e seguradoras, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação da apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social seguindo as normas e legislações aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder as consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Preenchimento das obrigações acessórias;
  • Atuar em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, através de feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias e opiniões e ser receptivo ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Entender sobre as linhas de serviço da EY e incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência com P&D;
  • Experiência com os impostos CSLL, IRPJ;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento tributário
  • Inglês fluente.

O que oferecemos

Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

title: Financial Systems Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Financial Systems Analyst role at Conservation International

This position is based in Arlington, VA, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Bolivia, Peru, or Guyana.

Reporting to the Financial Systems Lead, this position supports CI’s current financial systems (Unit4 Business World and SAP Concur) and future systems, including a new cloud-based ERP system (Workday). The main focus is to support day‑to‑day operations by responding to help‑desk requests from system users globally and managing system security. This role also supports the generation of special financial and budget reports through SQL queries and advanced Excel applications as needed, and supports enhancement and development of existing and new applications, including design, data validation, testing, and training.

To be successful, you will need strong technical aptitude, experience as a user and a system manager, understanding of accounting and financial reporting, good customer service and communication skills, and the ability to triage and reprioritize case load. Patience with diverse user skill levels and determination to resolve issues timely are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Provide an approachable and responsive helpdesk service, supporting users of CI’s financial applications (Unit4 Business World and SAP Concur) globally.
  • Triage system issues/bugs raised by business users and work to find solutions.
  • Escalate complex issues as necessary, working with internal and external third parties to facilitate resolution.
  • Ensure timely follow‑up, resolution, and documentation of service requests.
  • Maintain financial system integrity, including setting up, administering, and terminating user accounts and maintaining complex workflow structures.
  • Support data quality checks and monitor changes to keep system records up‑to‑date.
  • Work with system providers and IT to facilitate installation and migration of software patches and upgrades.
  • Create and maintain system configuration to ensure optimal processing.
  • Assist in using, developing, and implementing financial system applications.
  • Support testing activities on finance projects, assisting with UAT for new systems, processes, and updates affecting finance operations.
  • Design special‑purpose reports for audits or other management uses.
  • Design processes and procedures for getting data into and out of financial systems as needed.
  • Maintain custom reports and forms in BW using BW report engine tools.
  • Maintain AG16s (SQL‑based customizations) in BW.
  • Participate in ad‑hoc tasks or projects as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions

Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 4‑6 years of related experience in providing support for financial systems as a super user or system administrator.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Solid working knowledge of relational and/or OLAP databases.
  • Experience working with MS SQL Server.
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools, particularly Power BI.
  • Accuracy and strong attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey financial or technical information to non‑financial/technical stakeholders.
  • Pro‑active problem‑solving approach.
  • Ability to plan own workload and resolve conflicting priorities, accountable for own actions.
  • Flexibility and adaptability.
  • Continually seeking ways to improve processes.
  • Passion, drive, and curiosity to challenge and ask questions.
  • English is the working language of the organization and this role.

Preferred

  • Experience with Business World Financials, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Timesheets, and reporting modules.
  • Familiarity with Unit4 BW reporting tools and SQL‑based customizations (AG16s).
  • Cloud‑based ERP system implementation experience (e.g., Unit4 ERPx, Microsoft Dynamics F&O, Workday).
  • Experience with Workday Financials, Adaptive, or other Workday products.
  • Experience with SAP Concur administration.
  • Experience in the INGO sector.
  • Foreign language fluency, especially Spanish, French, and Portuguese.

To apply

Please submit a resume, cover letter, and respond to the position‑based questions in your application.

description:
Process Engineer - Rio at Hanwha Ocean

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, RJ, BR

Requisition ID: 1286

Overview

Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units. The Energy Plant Unit is proud to announce the establishment of new Global Business Centers, marking a significant milestone toward becoming a project‑centric and client‑driven organization.

Position Overview

The Process Engineer leads and controls process engineering activities. The Principal Process Engineer performs checks and reviews all data requested by the Client for approval, provides assessments on the performance of engineers, and ensures that engineering work and deliverables in the process discipline are accurate and correct to code, standards, and project specifications. The role may require frequent travel to the US, Europe, and Asia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand project requirements, scope of work, and project schedule.
  • Supervise Senior and Junior Process Engineers from project start to finish.
  • Ensure all engineering documents are prepared and developed in accordance with relevant design codes, standards, and client specifications.
  • Provide engineering expertise and support or report to the Manager of Process to ensure engineering progress meets timelines.
  • Ensure process and utility systems are optimized, efficient, safe, and environmentally compliant.

Assist in Project in Bidding or FEED Stage

  • Provide engineering review and support for bid proposals, including estimate of man‑hour and cost.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and FEED verification.

Process Engineering

  • Develop process calculations, studies, and deliverables.
  • Review process simulation and results, including heat and material balances, for accuracy of calculations.
  • Review all process engineering packages and deliverables (Sizing, Calculation, Report, PFD, PID, etc.).

Participation in Various Workshops

  • Chair HAZOP, Vendor HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, Design Review, and others.
  • Lead engineers to close out comments/punches/recommendations from HAZOP, Vendor HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, Design Review, etc.
  • Manage and report status of comments/recommendations.

Control 3rd Party and Sub‑Contractor

  • For special process study, contract, and selection through technical evaluation of 3rd party.
  • Manage 3rd Party work scope and review, comment, and approve 3rd Party output.
  • Control subcontractor performance and check quality of diagrams from subcontractor.

Participation and Support for Commissioning and Startup

  • Develop/review relevant philosophies and procedures.
  • Provide engineering support for construction, commissioning, and operation teams.

Management of Engineering

  • Ensure that process engineering output aligns with project objectives, schedule, and budget.
  • Generate regular progress reports.
  • Report engineering outstanding and concerns to the Discipline Manager with technical summaries of outstanding issues.

Problem Solving and Addressing Engineering Concerns

  • Provide engineering expertise for decision making to resolve process‑related issues.
  • Address engineering punches and comments.

Coordination and Communication

  • Lead engineering meetings with client, engineering subcontractor, and generate MOM.
  • Coordinate with detailed engineering consultants or client, vendors, and subcontractors.
  • Manage interface with all relevant disciplines to get necessary information for process engineering or to provide data to other disciplines.
  • Raise technical queries, RFIs, and others to obtain necessary information/Client approval.
  • Provide clarification/answer to Client’s request.

Monitoring and Mentoring

  • Teach, instruct, and guide less experienced Process Engineers.

Qualifications

  • At least a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Petroleum or Chemical Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent certification is a plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in process engineering in the offshore oil and gas industry.
  • Extensive knowledge of process engineering practices, principles, industry codes and standards, and an understanding of scientific methods of problem‑solving.
  • Proven track record of success in developing and performing Topsides Process Conceptual / Feasibility Studies during pre‑FEED/FEED or tender stage; prior experience with FPSO or FLNG design development and/or engineering project delivery (e.g., at a top‑tier FPSO contractor) is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of offshore industry terminology, concepts, and practices.
  • Knowledge of class rule, recognized code, standard, and skill of process engineering tools such as Aspen HYSYS, Flarenet, Pipe‑net or equivalent, and ability to interpret results of process simulation.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, with strong attention to detail and accuracy; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Fluency in English.

Mid‑Senior level

title: Principal Cost Controls Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Principal Cost Controls Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices to improve cost and schedule. They will be tasked with solving complex cost management problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Cost Controls Specialist may be required to guide junior personnel. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in costing and broad knowledge of the costing discipline within the project controls function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management is preferred
  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.
  • Must have experience in a large-scale mega-project in Oil & Gas and Offshore Construction.
  • Highly competent in the use of critical project management concepts such as EVM, project planning, risk analysis, and progress measurement.
  • Experienced in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Project Management Professional is a plus.
  • Understanding of Cost and Progress management systems is a plus.
  • Work independently with little or no supervision.
  • Great communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.
  • Experienced in both Cost and Schedule with a focus on Cost Management.
  • Understand the relationship between estimating, cost management, progress, schedule, and project accounting.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Implement McDermott processes and systems on projects.
  • Lead the project controls team on large and highly complex EPC projects.
  • Implement constructability concepts, (the how it’s built) and related interdependencies between Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction in support of the Advanced Work Planning (AWP) process.
  • Support the development of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) on complex projects with multiple partners and compensation types.
  • Implement internal and contractual requirements on the project via the project controls execution plan.
  • Lead setup and implementation of project controls systems.
  • Responsible for the accuracy of project controls reports.
  • Analyze and interpret cost forecasting and trending.
  • Recommends solutions or recovery plans for problem areas.
  • Lead preparation and review of the project monthly forecast.
  • Support the Project Controls Team in development of the cost spread and cash flows.
  • Participate in proposal development, commercial alignment and project kickoff processes.
  • Supervise and train junior personnel in all aspects of cost reporting.
  • Lead the set up and maintenance of the progress measurement system.
  • Implement and support the Change Management process.
  • Lead change management efforts, including building of cost estimates and apply or manage amendments to the contract.
  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.
  • Support the development and implementation of the Project Risk and Opportunity process.
  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
1 month ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Required Qualifications

  • Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.
  • Hold a current valid medical license.
  • Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.
  • Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.
  • Fluency in English.

Reports to:

Spa Manager

Job Summary

The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures, safely and effectively, and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions, safely and effectively, to address the concerns of onboard guests. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi–Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi‑Spa Physicians if necessary. The Medi‑Spa Physicians are expected to gain the knowledge of the spa services and products in effort to cross‑promote these services to guests. The Medi‑Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi – Spa Sales Consultant.

Position Requirements

  • Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests;
  • Work closely with the Medi–Spa Sales Consultant;
  • Must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills;
  • Must be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi‑spa services;
  • Enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality;
  • Excellent communication and listening skills;
  • Basic computer knowledge;
  • Must be a team player.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.
  • Provide consistent professional medi‑spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld’s medi‑spa protocols.
  • Conduct patient follow‑up as required.
  • Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.
  • Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control.
  • Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.
  • Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager’s office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years (3 years on Cunard and P&O).
  • Cross‑promote other spa services.
  • Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure.
  • Properly clean and restock medi‑spa treatment room as required.
  • Manage medical product and supply inventory.
  • Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention.
  • Handle guests’ questions and concerns professionally and courteously.
  • Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests.
  • Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment.
  • Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa.
  • Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings.
  • Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management.
  • Train new spa staff in medi‑spa services/cross‑promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions.
  • Follow Medi‑Spa Operations Policies.
  • Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report.

General Guidelines

  • For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service.
  • All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms. Doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest.
  • At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy.
  • Conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them, schedule a follow‑up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk.
  • Clean your room and set up for your next guest.
  • Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest. This means the room must be:
  • Clean – sanitize work surfaces and sink area; store trash in proper receptacles.
  • Organized – stock boxes should be out of sight and all supplies must be organized or stored properly.
  • Inviting – the treatment bed must be properly dressed and proper ambiance with regards to music and temperature.

End of Day Checklist

  • Dispose of open unused needles.
  • Dispose of Bio‑Hazard bag if full.
  • Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full.
  • Sterilize table and countertops.
  • Fill out inventory control form.
  • Email daily revenue report to shore side team.

Service booking policy

A clean, non‑intimidating, state‑of‑the‑art and stress‑free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. A critical element to the success of our spa is our ability to work together as a team. If we are unable to work seamlessly together, our guest will be the first to notice. It will not only hurt the business of our spa but will affect your individual success in this industry. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention:

  • Medi‑Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer.
  • In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services if you are not qualified to perform all services.
  • Medi‑Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager’s approval. All staff members are required to perform general duties during their scheduled hours, as directed by the manager onboard. General duties may include, but are not limited to, promotional duties, port cleaning, staff meetings, training and stock inventory. Please be guided by your Spa Manager’s instructions.

Guidelines for Protection and Sanitization (known as ‘GPS’)

  • Be familiar with OneSpaWorld’s ‘GPS’ to safety.
  • Understand and practice the required self‑screening procedures.
  • Understand and follow the agreed upon procedures for symptomatic guests or employees.
  • Understand and adhere to staff and guest Physical Distancing Policy.
  • Understand and adhere to Staff Personal Hygiene Policy.
  • Understand and adhere to the Hand Washing Policy.
  • Arrive at the spa between five and ten minutes prior to assigned shift start time.
  • Understand proper use and disposal of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the modality and for handling soiled linen, waste, and chemicals.
  • Be familiar with the approved disinfecting products available at the spa location including proper use, contact time, disinfection methods and proper storage and handling procedures.
  • Understand and adhere to the Treatment Room Preparation requirements.
  • Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable modality and services performed.
  • Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable spa area.
  • Understand the Sanitation Log Policy and complete logs as required.
  • Understand and adhere to the Retail Product Handling and Transferring Procedure.
  • Understand and adhere to the Product Sampling Procedure.
