description:
Engenheiro de Implantação de Projetos Pleno

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores:
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro(a) de Implantação de Projetos Pleno que será responsável pela execução e gestão de obras na área de gás, como gasodutos, SCCs, pontos de entrega e recebimento, estações de compressão, entre outros. A atuação será voltada ao acompanhamento técnico e operacional das obras, garantindo segurança, qualidade, cumprimento de prazos e integridade dos ativos.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar empresas contratadas na implantação das obras
  • Acompanhar a execução física e financeira dos projetos, priorizando segurança do trabalho e qualidade técnica
  • Oferecer suporte técnico às equipes contratadas, promovendo alta produtividade
  • Elaborar, revisar e consolidar documentos técnicos para contratação de serviços (memoriais descritivos, cartas-convite, RFPs, termos de abertura)
  • Definir estratégias de contratação alinhadas às prioridades da NTS e aos requisitos dos projetos
Requisitos
  • Formação superior em Engenharia
  • Experiência em execução e gerenciamento de obras, preferencialmente no setor de gás
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de acompanhamento de cronogramas (MS Project, Excel, Primavera)
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (3 a 4 dias por semana)
  • CNH ativa
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com elaboração de análise de risco
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de transporte por dutos ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência com análise e gerenciamento de riscos
  • Inglês técnico desejável
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Aqui, você será parte de uma empresa sólida, com propósito claro e que valoriza o bem‑estar, o respeito.

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que contribui para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, garantindo o transporte seguro e sustentável de gás natural.

Na Bemisa, todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas, independente de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Valorizamos um ambiente em que todos se sintam engajados e capazes de contribuir com suas habilidades para impulsionar nosso crescimento.

E para continuar construindo uma cultura inclusiva e diversa, contamos com a candidatura de bons profissionais como você para as futuras oportunidades na nossa empresa.

Modelo de trabalho

Área Operacional: Formato presencial com atuação em horário administrativo ou escala de turno;

Área Corporativa: Formato híbrido com atuação presencial quatro dias por semana e um dia home office.

Você está se candidatando ao nosso Banco de Talentos , criado exclusivamente para pessoas com deficiência que desejam desenvolver o seu potencial, explorar diversas áreas de atuação e conhecer mais sobre o setor de mineração.

Assim que surgir uma oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil, entraremos em contato. Enquanto isso, mantenha seu currículo atualizado para que possamos conhecer mais sobre você.

As vagas serão para as regiões:

  1. Belo Horizonte/MG
  2. Água Azul do Norte/PA
  3. Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Benefícios

Nosso atuais benefícios são:

  • Plano de Saúde (Titular e dependentes);
  • Assistência Funeral;
  • Refeição Local;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Wellhub - Plataforma de atividades físicas e bem estar;
  • Apoiopass - Programa especial de apoio e cuidado para colaboradores e familiares;
  • Programa Empresa Cidadã - Licença maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.

Com 17 anos de experiência, atualmente estamos presentes em todas as regiões do país, com um portfólio diversificado que engloba uma ampla gama de minerais, tais como minério de ferro, ouro, níquel, terras raras, fosfato e calcário.

Possuímos projetos em diferentes etapas da atividade mineral, desde a fase de exploração até a operação, e contamos com cerca de 1000 colaboradores por todo o Brasil engajados em nosso propósito.

A Mina Baratinha, localizada no Vale do Aço em Minas Gerais, possui uma capacidade de produção de aproximadamente 2,5 milhões de toneladas anuais de minério de ferro de alto teor e baixos níveis de contaminantes. Além disso, em julho de 2023, demos início à implantação do Projeto Mongais, com capacidade de produção de 1,0 milhão de toneladas por ano, dentro do Complexo de Baratinha. Já em Água Azul, primeira operação de ouro do Grupo Bemisa, está localizada no sul do Pará e iniciou sua fase de comissionamento em 2023.

Acreditamos no potencial da mineração do Brasil e temos como compromisso a integração da sustentabilidade em nossas operações, gerando desenvolvimento socioeconômico em todas as regiões em que atuamos.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Digital Growth Content Specialist
description:
MonetizeMore builds industry‑leading ad technology that is seen by more than 300M+ people per month. The company has been running for 15 years, achieving consistent double‑digit growth each year with a team of 100+ members spread across the globe.

We are a culture‑centric organization where Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen unite for excellence. We meticulously cultivate these pillars at the heart of everything we do, and our 100% remote setup allows us to work anywhere while upholding these values.

Role Summary

We’re looking for a versatile Social Media & Creative Growth Specialist to own and execute the content, design, and growth strategy across social platforms — including YouTube — to elevate MonetizeMore’s brand, engage publishers, and drive inbound lead generation. This role blends creative design, storytelling, and growth strategy to make complex ad‑tech topics accessible, build trust, and generate qualified publisher interest.

The ideal candidate will be a cross‑functional producer: part designer, part content strategist, part growth marketer — comfortable with graphic design, video creation, and social strategy, and passionate about turning ad‑tech know‑how into compelling content with real business impact.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Content & Video Strategy (YouTube + Social)
    • Plan, produce, and publish high‑quality videos, tutorials, explainers, and thought‑leadership content that address publisher pain points (e.g., policy compliance, invalid‑traffic prevention, monetization best practices).
    • Develop and manage a content calendar for YouTube and social media channels aligned with company goals, ad‑tech news, and publisher needs.
    • Optimize video metadata, thumbnails, and descriptions to maximize discoverability, SEO, and engagement.
  • Graphic & Visual Design
    • Create visually compelling graphics, diagrams, infographics, and motion‑graphics that simplify and clarify complex ad‑tech concepts.
    • Design assets for marketing, sales enablement, social posts, blog posts, product announcements, and educational content.
  • Social Media Management & Community Engagement
    • Manage and grow MonetizeMore’s presence across relevant social platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, etc.).
    • Engage with publisher and industry audiences, respond to comments/questions, and foster community trust and thought leadership.
    • Repurpose content across formats (short‑form, long‑form, image, video) to maximize reach and engagement.
  • Lead Generation & Brand Awareness
    • Use content and social strategy to attract high‑intent publisher leads searching for ad‑tech solutions or publisher support.
    • Collaborate with sales and marketing to align content with lead‑gen goals and track performance metrics (views, engagement, leads, conversions).
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with product, sales, ad operations, and client success teams to understand product features, publisher pain points, and trends — then translate into content.
    • Support sales enablement with video and visual collateral (case studies, product explainers, onboarding content, policy update guides).
  • Continuous Improvement & Analytics
    • Track performance of content (video views, watch time, engagement, conversion to leads).
    • Analyze what works, iterate on content strategy, and continuously optimize for growth, reach, and revenue impact.

Qualifications & Skills

Required:

  • 3‑5 related years of experience.
  • Demonstrable experience in graphic design and video content creation (e.g., editing, motion graphics, thumbnails, design software).
  • Strong familiarity with YouTube (or other video platforms) — content production, optimization, SEO best practices, and audience growth.
  • Experience managing social media channels for a brand or B2B company.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical/ad‑tech topics into clear, audience‑friendly content.
  • Creative mindset with a strategic growth orientation — comfortable thinking about content as a lead‑gen and branding asset, not just marketing fluff.
  • Ability to work in a fully remote, cross‑functional environment, collaborating with teams across time zones.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Background or familiarity with ad‑tech, digital publishing, programmatic advertising, or related industry.
  • Experience producing explainer videos, motion graphics, educational content, or tutorials.
  • Understanding of SEO, video SEO, and content performance analytics.
  • Experience supporting sales or business development teams through creative/sales‑enablement collateral.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Enterprise Account Executive

We are a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.

Apply if you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system – Ubuntu – to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long‑term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long‑term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do — at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer — a real understanding of customer needs, industry‑specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect — the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology — a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork — a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy — the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow‑up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account winsSelf‑discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional Skills Of Interest

  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence — in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

description:
Pessoa Técnica em Edificações | Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura

A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data‑driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Dentro da diretoria de Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura, a Fábrica de Cenários é a área responsável pela construção e entrega dos cenários que dão vida às produções de entretenimento, dramaturgia e eventos do Grupo Globo.

Reúne profissionais das mais diversas disciplinas — carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamentos e gestão técnica — que transformam projetos criativos em estruturas físicas com excelência técnica e artística.

Nosso desafio é equilibrar inovação, qualidade e velocidade de produção, em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em constante evolução, que integra arte, engenharia e tecnologia.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar tecnicamente a execução de obras e montagens cenográficas, garantindo o cumprimento dos projetos, cronogramas e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Realizar medições, levantamentos e controle de execução das etapas construtivas (carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamento, elétrica, etc.);
  • Realizar leitura de projetos, cortes e detalhamentos técnicos em projetos, assegurando a compatibilização entre os projetos de arquitetura, cenografia e infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar o time de orçamentos e suprimentos com informações técnicas e quantitativos de materiais;
  • Acompanhar fornecedores e prestadores de serviços durante as etapas de produção e montagem, garantindo conformidade técnica e segurança;
  • Contribuir para o controle de qualidade e atualização de padrões técnicos e construtivos da Fábrica;
  • Apoiar a implementação de boas práticas de Lean Construction e melhoria contínua nos processos produtivos.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação técnica completa em Edificações;
  • Experiência prévia em obras civis, cenográficas ou de estruturas temporárias;
  • Domínio com Projetos (leitura, interpretação e elaboração de plantas);
  • Conhecimento básico em medições, orçamentos e acompanhamento de obras;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Fábrica de Cenários e eventuais deslocamentos para estúdios e locações externas.
  • Conhecimento em Revit, SketchUp ou softwares 3D voltados à construção e cenografia;
  • Experiência em projetos de televisão, eventos, espetáculos ou produção de cenários;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Construction e metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de equipes multidisciplinares e integração de disciplinas;
  • Curso complementa­rio em Segurança do Trabalho ou Gestão de Projetos.

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

No Live Entertainment, temos The Town e Lollapalooza Brasil em parceria com a C3. Na área de Conteúdo, temos os espetáculos originais, como o Uirapuru, o The Town O Musical, e o Amazônia Para Sempre.   • Monitorar e responder a incidentes de segurança, administrando e otimizando ferramentas como SIEM, EDR, DLP, IAM, Firewall e WAF.
  • Implementar e monitorar controles de segurança baseados em frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, etc.).
  • Elaborar e manter normas e políticas internas de segurança.

  • Realizar hardening de servidores, endpoints e redes.
  • Apoiar em testes de segurança (pentests) e contribuir para o processo de conscientização e treinamento de colaboradores em segurança (Awareness).

  • Experiência com redes (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPN, proxies, firewalls).
  • Vivência com ferramentas de SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR e antivírus corporativo.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de vulnerabilidades (Nessus, Qualys ou similares).

Quem somos

A indústria brasileira cria mais do que produtos, ela cria oportunidades e transforma vidas! No SENAI CETIQT nós trabalhamos para transformar vidas desenvolvendo oportunidades e soluções para uma indústria têxtil, química e de confecção mais inovadora, tecnológica e sustentável.

Antes de te apresentar quem somos é muito importante que você conheça o significado do nosso nome: SENAI significa Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Industrial e CETIQT é um Centro de Tecnologia da Indústria Química e Têxtil .

Só pelo significado dos nomes você já consegue entender a relevância e papel estratégico que a nossa instituição desempenha ao apoiar o sistema S (SENAI, SESI, IEL) e capacitar profissionais para as demandas da indústria brasileira.

Porém, nós vamos muito além da capacitação de profissionais por meio de graduações, pós-graduações e cursos de curta duração. Nós também desenvolvemos tecnologias, oferecemos consultorias em diversas áreas para empresas, microempreendedores e para a Defesa Estratégica do país, como as forças armadas, realizamos testes metrológicos acreditados pelo INMETRO, promovemos estudos de futuro, e personalizamos o ensino técnico para a necessidade das indústrias têxteis, de confecção e química.

Agora vamos entender um pouco mais sobre quem é o SENAI CETIQT. O SENAI CETIQT é um centro de excelência reconhecido nacionalmente pela sua capacidade de gerar conhecimento e inovação para as cadeias produtivas dos setores químico, têxtil e de confecção. Com mais de 75 anos de história, a instituição desempenha um papel fundamental no fortalecimento do futuro da indústria química e da moda, formando profissionais altamente capacitados, oferecendo consultorias especializadas e customizadas, e impulsionando o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, processos e projetos de pesquisa.

Alinhado às necessidades da indústria brasileira e às principais tendências globais, o SENAI CETIQT se dedica a promover a inovação, a sustentabilidade e a competitividade da indústria nacional, consolidando-se como um pilar essencial para o crescimento e a transformação do setor.

Apply for the Creative Strategist (Performance Creative) role at Darkroom , our next‑generation growth marketing firm that blends human strategy with AI commerce.

About Darkroom

Founded in 2017, Darkroom redefines what a modern agency can be. Powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer, we deliver rapid, data‑driven creative and measurable impact across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms.

We have driven billions in attributable revenue and are recognized among the fastest‑growing private companies (Inc. 5000) and the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders appear in Forbes 30 Under 30.

The Role

We seek a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media on Meta, TikTok, and other platforms. You’ll own the performance creative service, marrying creative storytelling with data‑informed design to produce high‑volume, high‑impact ads.

What you’ll do

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy for full‑funnel ad programs on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.
  • Short‑Form Video: Provide expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products through short‑form video.
  • Data Analysis: Translate marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts, using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and CTR.
  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards. You may also create assets in Figma, Photoshop, or Illustrator as needed.
  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with confidence and strategic rationale.
  • Performance Iteration: Monitor data with the marketing team, iterate creative, and improve results over time.

Qualification & Experience

  • 3+ years of creative strategy on performance ad programs, focusing on short‑form video and statics.
  • Portfolio showcasing performance ad work (short‑form video, motion, statics) with evidence of impact on metrics like hold rate or CTR.
  • Proficiency in Figma (including Auto Layout & Components) and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and in client presentations.
  • Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, etc.) to increase speed and volume.
  • Ability to turn vague goals into testable concepts and lead iterative improvements.
  • Customer‑centric mindset, adept at navigating client pushback and delivering actionable feedback.

Hard Disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative experience.
  • No portfolio or performance context.
  • Strategy‑only role with no hands‑on design ability.
  • Weak client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom demands high performance, creativity, and ownership. Remote‑first culture with flexibility; hybrid option for New York or Lisbon hubs starting early 2026. We offer extensive parental leave, ongoing learning across disciplines, and a culture of autonomy with accountability.

Equal Opportunity Statement

description:
Sua missão como Analista de Controles internos será

  • Mapear, documentar e redesenhar processos das áreas Contábil, Financeira, Fiscal, Custos e Controles Internos, garantindo aderência às políticas e padrões corporativos.
  • Modelar fluxos de processos utilizando BPMN 2.0 e ferramentas de modelagem (Bizagi, Visio, ARIS ou similares).

  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos, políticas e instruções de trabalho (POPs) das áreas da Controladoria.
  • Apoiar a integração entre Controles Internos e Processos, garantindo conformidade com padrões de auditoria e governança.
  • Realizar treinamentos e disseminar a cultura de eficiência, dados e processos nas áreas sob a Controladoria.
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de planos de ação oriundos de auditorias internas e externas.

Por isso esperamos que você possua

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas afins. Pós graduação em análise de dados será considerado diferencial.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.
  • Vivência em contabilidade societária e normas IFRS.
  • Pacote Office avançado, especialmente Excel, PowerPoint.
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Power BI.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento em SQL será considerado diferencial.
  • Participação em projetos de eficiência operacional, governança e adequação a requisitos SOX.

O que vai chamar nossa atenção

  • Experiência em análise de processos, indicadores e melhoria contínua.
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards gerenciais.
  • Atuação em ambientes corporativos com foco em eficiência operacional e controle de performance.

title: QUALITY CONTROL ANALYST - 2ND SHIFT
description:
At Guerbet, we build lasting relationships so that to enable people to live better. This is Our Purpose.

We are a global leader in medical imaging, offering an extensive portfolio of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, digital and AI solutions, for diagnostic and interventional imaging. As a pioneer in the field of contrast products since the last 100 years, we continuously innovate to improve the diagnosis, prognosis and quality of life of patients.

Customer Centricity, Cooperation, Audacity, Focus, and Responsibility are the values that we share and practice on a daily basis.

Working at Guerbet is not only being part of a multicultural team with nearly 3,000 people across more than 20 countries, but it is above all about playing a unique role in the future of medical imaging.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This person will actively participate in the company's Quality System to ensure that the physical and chemical analysis procedure is carried out on production materials, enabling the product to meet the required quality standards. This is a second shift position.

YOUR ROLE

  • Analysis of in-process product, finished product and raw material
  • Perform sample preparation, execute and interpret high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) analyse using Empower systems
  • Control the use and useful life of HPLC columns
  • Perform sample preparation, perform and interpret analyses using absorption spectrophotometry.
  • Perform sample preparation, execute and interpret titrimetry analyses in automatic titrators.
  • Sample identification by infrared
  • Review operational procedures
  • Develop procedures for new equipment
  • Record analytical results in the LIMS system
  • Perform/record OOS investigation
  • Understand, comply with, and respect HSE (Safety, Health, and Environment) procedures, instructions, and rules as part of your daily role and responsibilities, acting to ensure your own safety and contribute to the safety of others, always adopting safe behavior.
  • Exercise your commitment to HSE by participating in safety, health, and environment training and initiatives, and continually practice risk awareness in your daily work.

YOUR BACKGROUND

  • Experience in quality control, with good technical knowledge for analysis of in-process product, finished product, imported product and HPLC methods.
  • Degree in pharmacy or chemistry
  • Experience in pharmaceutical
  • Operational knowledge of liquid chromatography
  • GMP Good Laboratory Practices
  • Knowledge of European regulations related to the analysis routine.

WHY JOIN US

We offer continued personal development. When you join Guerbet, you:

  • Are choosing a global leader with recognized expertise in diagnostic and interventional imaging
  • Are joining our 3000 collaborators who are committed every day to offering innovative solutions to improve quality of patient’s life all over the world
  • Are joining a company where we value diversity of talents coming from various horizons

Do you want to help improve patients’ lives with us? We look forward to meeting you and continuing our story together!

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o SCLC para garantir o desempenho energético de equipamentos e serviços adquiridos.

  • Desenvolver, revisar e acompanhar os procedimentos operacionais do departamento.
  • Desenvolver o referencial de LSO (guias, manuais, regras da empresa).
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar o cronograma de auditorias marítimas, aéreas e terrestres.
  • Garantir a implementação adequada das regras da DGEP no departamento de logística.
  • Auxiliar o gerente de operações logísticas na implementação de ferramentas promovidas pelo HQ (KPI, PTS, competências…)
  • Desenvolver relatórios diários/semanais para cada atividade logística.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de digitalização.

Relatórios e Acompanhamento das Operações

  • Manter o banco de dados de desempenho do departamento.
  • Acompanhar e consolidar os indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Participar da análise dos KPIs.
  • Participar da implementação de ferramentas de KPIs conforme a evolução das atividades.
  • Manter e atualizar o Plano de Ação e Planejamento do Departamento.
  • Promover e manter o banco de dados de Melhoria Contínua dentro de LSO.
  • Participar das reuniões de Segurança e Qualidade (SQM) com os contratados de LSO e acompanhar as recomendações ou ações corretivas necessárias.

Orçamento e Finanças

  • Auxiliar o Gerente de LSO na elaboração do orçamento.
  • Interagir com controle de custos e departamento de contratos e compras para garantir o acompanhamento adequado do orçamento de LSO.
  • Verificar a exatidão das faturas de LSO e manter o controle de todas elas.
  • Auxiliar os responsáveis pelos contratos de LSO na preparação de documentos para CFT (convites para licitação), extensões contratuais ou qualquer outra solicitação relacionada aos contratos.
  • Auxiliar o responsável pelo contrato de LSO no processo de CFT e análise.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir que todos os membros de LSO estejam cientes desses bancos de dados.
  • Verificação de faturas e acompanhamento orçamentário.
  • Acompanhamento de contratos de LSO – Implementação do MAESTRO.

Perfil do Candidato

  • Boas habilidades organizacionais.
  • Comportamento proativo e orientado ao trabalho em equipe.
  • Automotivado, comprometido com a entrega de resultados.
  • Fortes habilidades de apresentação e análise.
  • Pessoa rigorosa, capaz de lidar com diferentes assuntos simultaneamente.

  • Excelente conhecimento de Excel, Word e PowerPoint.
  • Desejável conhecimento em PowerQuery, PowerBI e PowerApp.
  • Bom conhecimento de processos contratuais.

Formação e Experiência

title: Sales Trader de Renda Variável (Rio de Janeiro)
description:
Sobre nós

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande , Espírito Empreendedor , Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre nós

O nosso propósito é transformar o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Começamos em 2001, como um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de pessoas talentosas que, por meio da nossa cultura de Sonho Grande, Mente Aberta e Espírito Empreendedor, tiveram a autonomia e liberdade que precisavam para transformar o mercado financeiro.

Porém, sabemos que o desafio é muito maior. Os grandes bancos ainda possuem 95% do mercado de investimentos no Brasil, mas estamos aqui para romper essa lógica e melhorar a vida de muito mais pessoas. Somos exatamente o que o sistema financeiro nunca foi.

Se você se identifica com esses conceitos e deseja construir algo especial, mergulhe de cabeça nesta oportunidade.

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Sales Trader, você irá atuar auxiliando nossos clientes mais relevantes nas tomadas de decisão no universo da renda variável, levando em consideração o momento de mercado, a visão do nosso time de research e o perfil de cada investidor. Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Transmitir recomendações de operações de curto, médio e longo prazo, de acordo com o perfil do cliente;
  • Execução de operações nos mercados à vista, futuro e a termo;
  • Assessoria na montagem de operações estruturadas;
  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado; (alternativa: contato ativo com clientes que possuam carteira de ações acima de R$ 300 mil)
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

O que buscamos

Pré-requisitos para candidatura:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil Comercial;
  • Estar habituado em colocar o cliente no centro de nossas decisões;
  • Curiosidade em Renda Variável;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial no Rio de Janeiro;

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência prévia em mesa de operações;
  • Certificação CPA-20.

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

Sheryl Sandberg

Benefícios

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • Plano odontológico
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Zenklub
  • Seguro de Vida
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Vale Transporte
  • New Value (clube de benefícios)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Fundos de Investimentos Exclusivos
  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

title: Analista Mídias Pagas
description:
Job description

A área de Growth focada em Mídia Paga é responsável por acelerar o crescimento do negócio por meio da aquisição eficiente de usuários e geração de receita, utilizando canais pagos de forma estratégica, orientada por dados e experimentação contínua.

Sua atuação combina análise profunda do funil, gestão otimizada de investimentos, testes sistemáticos e integração com outras áreas para maximizar o impacto das campanhas.

Main responsibilities

Sua missão será:

1. Estratégia de Aquisição e Crescimento

  • Desenvolver e evoluir a estratégia de aquisição de clientes via canais pagos (Google, Meta, afiliados, programática, etc.).
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre metas de aquisição, ROI, payback e eficiência de CAC.
  • Construir e otimizar o funil de aquisição ponta a ponta (impressão → clique → conversão → receita → LTV).
  • Identificar novas alavancas de crescimento e oportunidades de escala sustentável.

2. Planejamento, Execução e Operação de Campanhas

  • Planejar, configurar e acompanhar campanhas full-funnel (branding, performance, remarketing e brandformance).
  • Estruturar contas de mídia com boas práticas de segmentação, criativos, lances e otimização.
  • Fazer gestão diária e semanal de budgets, pacing, previsibilidade e elasticidade de investimento.
  • Coordenar squads internos (CRM, Produto, Conteúdo, Branding) para maximizar o impacto das campanhas.

3. Otimização Contínua e Experimentação

  • Criar plano contínuo de testes A/B e incrementais (criativos, audiências, mensagens, páginas de destino).
  • Desenvolver backlog de experimentos com frameworks de priorização (ICE, PXL ou similar).
  • Monitorar e agir rapidamente sobre métricas-chave: CTR, CPC, CVR, CPA, CAC, ROAS e LTV.
  • Aplicar princípios de growth para descobrir novos caminhos de escala e eficiência.

4. Governança, Métricas e Análises Avançadas

  • Construir relatórios e dashboards de acompanhamento (GA4, Appsflyer, Looker/Data Studio ou similar).
  • Garantir integridade e consistência dos dados, incluindo tracking, UTMs e mapeamento de eventos.
  • Calcular e analisar impacto incremental de campanhas quando aplicável.

Requirements and skills

Para embarcar nesse desafio e se tornar um Beeper, você precisa ter:

1. Ferramentas e Plataformas (Domínio Esperado)

Ferramentas de Mídia

  • Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube).
  • Meta Ads Manager (campanhas de tráfego, conversão, remarketing e Advantage+).
  • Plataformas de afiliados e mídia programática (Taboola, DV360, outros) – desejável.
  • Ferramentas de automação e gestão de criativos (ex.: Smartly, Hunch) – diferencial.

Analytics e Atribuição

  • GA4 – criação de eventos, análise de funil, exploração, UTMs.
  • Appsflyer, Adjust ou similar – tracking de app, SKAN (desejável).
  • Looker Studio / Data Studio para construção de dashboards.
  • Conhecimento básico de BigQuery , SQL ou planilhas avançadas (Excel/Sheets).

Ferramentas Complementares

  • Plataformas de CRO (Hotjar, Clarity, VWO, Optimizely) – desejável.
  • Ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) – diferencial.
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Notion, Jira, Monday).

2. Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)

Essenciais

  • Sólida compreensão de métricas de performance: CPC, CPM, CTR, CVR, CPA, CAC, ROAS, LTV.
  • Capacidade de estruturar, otimizar e escalar campanhas full-funnel.
  • Experiência em testar criativos, audiências e hipóteses (A/B testing).
  • Habilidade em interpretar dashboards e transformar dados em insights acionáveis.
  • Entendimento de tracking, UTMs, tags, pixels e eventos.
  • Conhecimento sobre funis de app e web (instalação, signup, compra, eventos intermediários).

Desejáveis

  • Noção de estatística aplicada a testes (significância, erro, sizing).
  • Compreensão de modelos de atribuição e impacto incremental.
  • Vivência com campanhas mobile (App Campaigns, iOS 14+, SKAN).
  • Conhecimento básico de SQL para análises mais profundas.
  • Familiaridade com SEO e CRO, mesmo que em nível conceitual.

3. Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Mentalidade orientada a experimentação e crescimento.
  • Forte raciocínio analítico e habilidade de resolver problemas.
  • Organização, priorização e disciplina operacional.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de alinhar stakeholders.
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado rápido em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Perfil hands‑on, com senso de dono (ownership).

Additional information

Benefícios para os Beepers:

  • Para sua saúde e de seus dependentes – Plano de Saúde e Odontológico | Sulamérica;
  • Benefício Farmácia: até 40% de desconto em medicamentos;
  • Pacote de alimentação: VA/VR/Lanche todos os dias/Estações para um pit stop durante o dia;
  • Pensando na sua saúde física e mental: GymPass / Total Pass /Seguro de Vida;
  • Para seu desenvolvimento: descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras;
  • Vale transporte;

Jornada:

Diarista de segunda a sexta, no horário de 09h às 18h – Carga Horária: 200h

Local:

Botafogo - RJ

Fique tranquilo ao cadastrar seus dados na vaga. A Beep segue a LGPD – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei Federal 13.709/2018). Garantimos responsabilidade ao utilizar seus dados somente em nosso processo seletivo, para fins de cadastro e controle de candidatos.

Job Description:

What’s the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to shape Shell Brazil’s Climate and Carbon Management policy positions—including carbon markets, GHG management, Decarbonization technologies and — and align advocacy efforts with Shell’s business strategy and global policy (e.g., Article 6, IMO compliance). Also, assist in managing an integrated sustainability governance framework, helping leadership articulate sustainable practices and identify risks and opportunities beyond climate change.

What you’ll be doing

  • Support the development and maintenance of the Climate and Carbon Management policy positions in Brazil aligned with Shell Group strategy.
  • Help ensure accessibility and understanding of emerging laws and regulations across relevant business units and functions, translating their impact.
  • Support advocacy initiatives aimed at shaping regulations aligned with Shell’s strategic interests at both country and group levels, while representing the company in key coalitions (e.g., IBP, CEBDS) and think tanks (e.g., CEBRI).
  • Monitor and proactively flag challenges, risks, and opportunities from emerging regulations related to the climate and carbon agenda.
  • Secure and maintain reliable information to inform business decisions and strategic positioning.
  • Support the line manager to run and maintain an integrated governance framework for Shell Brazil’s sustainability agenda.
  • Help leadership articulate sustainable ways of working and identify opportunities to externally articulate our message.

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in related field.
  • 5–10 years of experience in a mix of business, government/diplomatic.
  • Experience in Issues Management and Crisis Management.
  • Good knowledge of governance and business control frameworks.
  • A good understanding of business drivers and potential risks relevant to the organization’s industry and operations.
  • A good knowledge and understanding of public policy and business and technical capabilities as they relate to the energy industry generally.
  • Good research and analytical skills are key.
  • Strong personal and business integrity.
  • Capacity to multi‑task and manage complexity.
  • Ability to manage and deliver against short deadlines.
  • Strong influencing/motivating skills and ability to drive delivery through others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; able to work effectively with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
  • Good communicator—verbal and written.

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

We’d like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here.

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer-focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell-branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Shell’s strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net‑zero emissions business by 2050.

As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

Exercer atividades relacionadas aos cuidados do paciente média e pequena complexidade, auxiliando a equipe de saúde na execução dos trabalhos em nível hospitalar, com foco no conforto do paciente.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar procedimentos referentes ao cuidado, tais como: prestar assistência aos pacientes através de cuidados de higienização, auxílio a alimentação, verificação de glicemia capilar, limpeza de materiais utilizados pelos pacientes, administrando medicamento via oral.
  • Comunicar prontamente aos profissionais de saúde quaisquer anormalidades constatadas;
  • Receber e passar plantão junto à equipe de enfermagem, tomando e/ou dando ciência de todas as anormalidades e eventuais ocorrências no período, com objetivo de garantir a comunicação efetiva para continuidade do cuidado;
  • Controlar e/ou efetuar desinfecção de materiais utilizados nos procedimentos através de técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH, registrando e informando dados, a fim de minimizar os riscos de transmissão de infecção;
  • Realizar o descarte de resíduos infectantes de acordo com a orientação da Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH e do Programa de Gerenciamento de Resíduos em Serviços de Saúde – PGRSS;

Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Ter curso concluído de cuidador
  • Ter experiência como cuidador de pacientes

Plantão 12X36 dia - 7h às 19h

A cadeia de saúde no Brasil tinha uma lacuna entre o modelo altamente tecnológico voltado para tratamento intensivo do hospital geral e o seu retorno para a sua residência.

Por este motivo, o Hospital Placi chegou para ocupar esse espaço no tratamento pós agudo, oferecendo um atendimento humanizado e acolhedor com uma proposta do cuidado individualizado para:

  • Reabilitação;
  • Readequação de cuidados;
  • Cuidados Paliativos Oncológicos e não oncológicos;

Inauguramos em 2013 a nossa primeira unidade em Niterói com a missão de: acolher, cuidar e recuperar pessoas. Não paramos por aí! Em 2016, expandimos para Botafogo e em breve novas unidades estarão próximas a você.

Nossa essência é "cuidar Bem é fazer Bem" e para isso contamos com uma equipe interdisciplinar com excelência técnica para fornecer todo o suporte aos pacientes, familiares e equipe assistente.

Seguimos com o propósito de trazer vida para todos os momentos de vida , levando o cuidado certo no momento certo!

Somos pessoas cuidando de pessoas. Atuamos com relação próxima e respeitosa, temos orgulho de fazer a diferença no cuidado de todos aqueles que precisam dos nossos serviços.

Mais do que um hospital de transição, somos um time que tem como propósito cuidar!

Quer fazer parte dessa história para cuidarmos juntos dos nossos pacientes?

Inscreva-se em uma de nossas oportunidades e venha ser um profissional do time Placi Cuidados Extensivos .

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer‑a‑friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high‑performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now

and become a valued part of our growing team!

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, pacote office avançado, etc.).

  • Conhecimento técnico em projetos navais, estruturas offshore, integração de sistemas e engenharia multidisciplinar.

  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas nacionais e internacionais, regulatórios da indústria naval/offshore.

OsRequisitos mínimos para a função são:

  • Bacharelado em Direito e OAB ativa.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação em Direito Empresarial, Contratos, Regulatório, Trabalhista ou Proteção de Dados.
